title: Navigation favorites and several reported issues
summary: This topic is loosely connected by mentions of "several" and includes both navigation-location setup comments and scattered complaints about multiple problems or unpleasant features.

positive.summary: The positive review praises the ability to save home locations as navigation favorites once the feature is understood.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe multiple vehicle problems, unpleasant feature usability, and reports of recurring issues noted by dealers.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mostly mention prior ownership of several vehicles, repeated contacts or attempts, or references to several locations without clear evaluative sentiment.

limitations: The cluster mixes unrelated subjects linked mainly by the word "several," so it does not represent a single coherent customer issue.
Many examples are undetermined and provide too little context to infer a clear opinion beyond the literal mention.
